class Solution:
    def isPossibleToSplit(self, nums: List[int]) -> bool:
        # Count frequency of each element
        from collections import Counter
        freq = Counter(nums)

        # Since we need two arrays of length len(nums) // 2 with all distinct elements,
        # it is not possible if any element appears more than len(nums) // 2 times.
        if any(v > (len(nums) // 2) for v in freq.values()):
            return False
        
        # Check if we can find len(nums) // 2 unique elements
        unique_elements = len(freq)
        if unique_elements < len(nums) // 2:
            return False
        
        return True
```
